instruction: A candid photographic still, medium shot, on a sunny outdoor rooftop. In the center foreground, the woman with short grey hair (R9) in a denim jacket and black skirt dances with arms outstretched, pouting playfully at the camera. In the left background, the woman in the black beanie and khaki capris (R8) stands dancing and smiling. In the center background, the woman in the neon green dress (R7) dances with one arm raised. In the right background, the man in the brown jacket (R10) dances and smiles. Warm, direct sunlight illuminates the scene.
